alex_sales: FYI customer (FinTech) asked if we can do an offline bundle delivery with encrypted transport + a rollback SLA for the POC. They want packaging details, upgrade cadence commitments, and a simple verification flow.

mira_se: quick checklist — we normally deliver chunked .tar.gz bundles, a manifest with sha256s, and a detached signature file. for airgapped installs we recommend: signed manifest, sbom, and delta bundles for updates.

raj_ops: bundle sizing note: quantized 7B ~12GB full model image; delta bundles typically 200–600MB. transfer estimate over USB3 (real world ~80–100MB/s): 12GB ~= 2–3 minutes to copy (plus verification). if they use USB2 or sneekernet edge-case add 4–6x time.

lina_security: security constraints: enterprise POCs that require non-repudiation must use HSM-backed signing (FIPS-140 if requested). offline signing flow: generate manifest -> HSM sign -> produce bundle.sig and manifest.sig. verification command we expect ops to run locally.

mira_se: sample verification commands we send in the runbook:
```
# verify signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
# verify checksums
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
```

raj_ops: short rollback playbook (POC-friendly):
1) drain traffic / stop inference service
2) swap artifact to previous-release.tar.gz
3) run DB migration rollback (if we applied any schema)
4) start service and monitor metrics for 5–10m; run health-checks
we can template this as an ansible playbook for the POC.

alex_sales: customer also asked about upgrade cadence — they want quarterly functional updates and emergency hotfix capability. is quarterly OK? what about CVE response times?

lina_security: quarterly functional updates are OK as a baseline. for security we recommend a 6-week vulnerability patching SLA (test + validation window) and an emergency hotfix path (signed, audited, and timeboxed). hotfixes require signed approval + audit trail. include in SOW.

mira_se: ops constraint: delta updates require the same base image hash. if customer uses immutable nodes we recommend a blue/green swap with the offline operator. for POC we can deliver a bootable image + delta patch bundles to minimize size.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: RI-4621 — "Airgapped POC transport + signing playbook" assigned to raj_ops, mira_se :bell:

alex_sales: pricing question: do we charge extra for HSM signing or offline support during POC? one-off setup vs recurring?

mira_se: HSM integration usually has a small flat setup fee for POC (admin + signing configuration). long-term HSM usage is typically billed as an add-on or part of enterprise package. i'll draft two options (one-off + recurring) for SOW.

raj_ops: ops caveat: if they insist on sneakernet checkpoints, require both checksum + detached signature verification in runbook. we can provide an rsync+gpg verification flow instead of openssl if they prefer GPG trust model.

lina_security: also call out root CA rotation: offline sites need a manual rotation path unless we provide a physical token or on-prem rotation orchestrator. rotation window for offline is typically yearly; call it out as an operational constraint.

alex_sales: next steps: mira to draft SOW + ops checklist by EOD Tue, raj to provide transfer times and an ansible rollback snippet, lina to add the security appendix (HSM + rotation + hotfix process). i'll share with customer after we have the draft.

mira_se: ack :thumbsup:

raj_ops: ack

lina_security: ack
